name: Ayushi Singhal
body: Ayushi is a Curator at PUCAR, where she has anchored the mission since 2022. A practising advocate at the High Courts of Bombay and Rajasthan, she was previously a disputes associate at Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, clerked for Justice D.Y. Chandrachud at the Supreme Court of India, and assisted the Srikrishna Committee on arbitration reform at Vidhi. She studied law at NUJS Kolkata, where she also taught tort and constitutional law.
